description: What things cost on restaurant menus in a city: the middle price, and the middle half of prices, of an espresso, a cappuccino, a beer, a glass of wine, a margherita, a burger, a main course, a lunch offer, a cola and a bottle of still water, read from the menus on restaurants', cafes' and bars' own websites, with the number of menus behind each figure, the day they were read and how many prices a hand check found right. Covers 13 European cities so far (Paris, Madrid, Berlin, Milan, Lisbon, Vienna and others); without a city it lists them. Figures are menu prices, not what a bill comes to.

city.description: City slug, for example paris or madrid; leave out for the list of cities with prices
